name: present-in-html
description: Presentations as one self-contained HTML file: plan an outline, build the deck (32 themes, presenter view, PDF, Arabic/RTL, built-in checker), review it against the audience, time slot and Winston's speaking rules, edit its wording in a click-and-type editor, and publish it to GitHub Pages; or run the whole plan-build-review-publish workflow with Opus and Sonnet agents.
